description: Signed item writes (docs/crypto.md): statement = "kemlock/v1/item-write" || owner (17) || item id (16) || lp(kind) || u64be(revision) || u64be(revision - 1) || u8(deleted) || envelope_hash (32) || writer id (16) || u32be(writer key version) || u8(0), or u8(1) || collection id (16) (a collection exactly when the owner is a space); envelope_hash = SHA-256(u32be(key_version) || lp(ciphertext) || lp(item_key)), or 32 zero bytes for a tombstone; signature = sig1 signature of the writer's own key under context "item-write" over the statement (3373 bytes); stored = writer id (16) || u32be(writer key version) || signature. The signature must not verify under a wrong context or over any changed statement.
